dependencies.note: Missing dependencies are environment gaps, not confirmed incompatibilities.

research_interpretation: The archived PyTOPKAPI package contains Python syntax failures and has missing dependencies in the current environment. Nevertheless, its original Green-Ampt infiltration implementation passed two archived scientific tests without source modifications and produced identical numerical results across three independent subprocess executions. This demonstrates component-level executability, not whole-package executability or reproduction of published results.
limitations: Only two original infiltration tests were executed.
The complete PyTOPKAPI package was not imported.
No complete hydrological simulation was performed.
The three runs used the same software environment.
The numerical expectations came from archived tests.
The source syntax defects cannot automatically be attributed to age-related code decay.
The four syntax corrections were tested in memory only.
